abstract: Salesforce reported strong fourth quarter fiscal 2024 results, highlighting the expansion of its Einstein AI platform which processes over 200 billion AI predictions daily across Customer 360 applications. The Einstein 1 platform enables organizations to build AI-powered applications through low-code development tools and integrated generative AI assistants.
keyFindings: Salesforce Einstein platform processes over 200 billion AI predictions per day across Customer 360 applications
Einstein 1 platform provides low-code development capabilities for building AI-powered applications
Generative AI assistants are integrated into the Einstein 1 platform offering
methodology: Company earnings announcement and product capability disclosure. Not a research study.
qualifiers: Limited to excerpt provided; full earnings report content not available in source text. Specific metrics limited to platform usage statistics without comparative growth data.
